title: The new displays are not offered below the desktop screen width
custom_preconds:
1. On the Work Orders QA build (Board View / Tech View on), signed in with Work Orders view permission.
  2. Seed / setup: have eligible lead technicians and work orders at the location; a phone or a browser window narrowed below the desktop breakpoint.
custom_steps:
1. On a desktop-width screen, confirm the List, Tech View and Board View display options are offered.
  2. Narrow the window below the desktop breakpoint (or open on a phone) and read the Work Orders page.
  3. Look for the Tech View and Board View display options at that width.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Below the desktop breakpoint the Tech View and Board View displays are withheld and the page keeps today's mobile List (an interim state until the phone/tablet design exists - not the final V-2 requirement).
  • At desktop width all three displays are available again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders - Board View & Tech View); Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (engineering tech plan .md, provided 2026-09-30), section 1.4 Clarifications; read 30 Sep 2026. Specified by the tech plan / Product clarification and not covered by the PRD stories.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Clarification - Phone and tablet layouts (V-2, UX-20): “Design does not exist. Phase 13 keeps today's mobile List and withholds the new displays below the desktop breakpoint - an interim state, not the V-2 requirement.”
